23072-the-voyage-of-the-steadfast-the-yo.title: The Voyage Of The Steadfast The Young Missionaries In The Pa
23072-the-voyage-of-the-steadfast-the-yo.creator: W.H.G. Kingston.
23072-the-voyage-of-the-steadfast-the-yo.description: A book by W.H.G. Kingston.. "I saw the flash of a gun, mother. It is in the direction of those dark rocks which lift their heads above the water!" exclaimed Hannah. I heard the sound also. There is another flash! They must have come from some unfortunate ship. Perhaps she is already on the rocks. Can any boat venture out to her assistance in a storm like this? I will shut the window directly, mother," she added, looking round, and trying to catch the fluttering curtains.

arxiv-2107-01906.title: THE LAST-ITERATE CONVERGENCE RATE OF OPTIMISTIC MIRROR DESCENT IN STOCHASTIC VARIATIONAL INEQUALITIES
arxiv-2107-01906.creator: Waïss Azizian ∗, Franck Iutzeler †, Jérôme Malick ‡, Panayotis Mertikopoulos ♯
arxiv-2107-01906.description: Abstract . In this paper, we analyze the local convergence rate of OMD methods in stochastic VI , a class of optimization problems with important applications to learning theory and machine learning. Our analysis reveals an intricate relation between the algorithm’s rate of convergence and the local geometry induced by the method’s underlying Bregman function.

arxiv-2107-09304.title: Parametric Study for Optimal Performance of Coulomb-Coupled Quantum Dots Journal: J. Phys.: Condens. Matter
arxiv-2107-09304.creator: Kum Hyok Jong, Song Mi Ri, Chol Won Ri
arxiv-2107-09304.description: Abstract We study the optimal output power and efficiency of the three-terminal quantum heat engine with Coulomb-coupled quantum-dots (CCQD). It has been well known that in the weak coupling regime, two kinds of dominant transport mechanisms are sequential tunneling and cotunneling processes in CCQD.

arxiv-2202-06736.title: Minimizing Entropy to Discover Good Solutions to Recurrent Mixed Integer Programs
arxiv-2202-06736.creator: Charly Robinson La Rocca, Emma Frejinger, Jean-François Cordeau
arxiv-2202-06736.description: Abstract Current state-of-the-art solvers for mixed-integer programming (MIP) problems are designed to perform well on a wide range of problems. However, for many real-world use cases, problem instances come from a narrow distribution. This has motivated the development of specialized methods that can exploit the information in historical datasets to guide the design of heuristics.

arxiv-2304-03725.title: An Infinitary Model of Diagrammatic Calculus in Unbiased Monoidal Categories
arxiv-2304-03725.creator: Vihaan Dheer
arxiv-2304-03725.description: Abstract Properties of morphisms represented by so-called ‘string diagrams’ of monoidal categories (and their braided and symmetric derivatives), mainly their resistance in value to isotopic deformation, have made the usage of graphical calculi commonplace in category theory ever since the correspondence between diagrams and tensor categories was rigorously established by Joyal and Street in 1991.

arxiv-2310-16034.title: The Photon Sphere and Response Functions in Holography
arxiv-2310-16034.creator: Marcos Riojas a, Hao-Yu Sun a
arxiv-2310-16034.description: Abstract In this letter, we show the Unruh temperature of the photon sphere for an AdS 4 -Schwarzschild black hole can be determined holographically from the retarded Green’s function and is proportional to its circumference according to a boundary observer.

arxiv-2405-10828.title: Analysis of Impulsive Interference in Digital Audio Broadcasting Systems in Electric Vehicles
arxiv-2405-10828.creator: 1 st Chin-Hung Chen, 2 nd Wen-Hung Huang, 3 rd Boris Karanov, 4 th Alex Young, 5 th Yan Wu, 6 th Wim van Houtum
arxiv-2405-10828.description: Abstract Recently, new types of interference in electric vehicles (EVs), such as converters switching and/or battery chargers, have been found to degrade the performance of wireless digital transmission systems. Measurements show that such an interference is characterized by impulsive behavior and is widely varying in time.

arxiv-2503-02091.title: Which Code Statements Implement Privacy Behaviors in Android Applications?
arxiv-2503-02091.creator: Chia-Yi Su, Aakash Bansal, Vijayanta Jain, Sepideh Ghanavati, Sai Teja Peddinti, Collin McMillan, Chia-Yi Su, Aakash Bansal, Vijayanta Jain, Sepideh Ghanavati, Sai Teja Peddinti, Collin McMillan
arxiv-2503-02091.description: Abstract A “privacy behavior” in software is an action where the software uses personal information for a service or a feature, such as a website using location to provide content relevant to a user. Programmers are required by regulations or application stores to provide privacy notices and labels describing these privacy behaviors.

arxiv-2505-22129.title: What Makes for Text to 360-degree Panorama Generation with Stable Diffusion?
arxiv-2505-22129.creator: Jinhong Ni, Chang-Bin Zhang, Qiang Zhang, Jing Zhang
arxiv-2505-22129.description: Abstract Recent prosperity of text-to-image diffusion models, e.g . Stable Diffusion, has stimulated research to adapt them to 360-degree panorama generation. Prior work has demonstrated the feasibility of using conventional low-rank adaptation techniques on pre-trained diffusion models to generate panoramic images.

arxiv-2601-06560.title: Lightweight Resolution-Aware Audio Deepfake Detection via Cross-Scale Attention and Consistency Learning Journal: Knowledge-Based Systems
arxiv-2601-06560.creator: K. A. Shahriar
arxiv-2601-06560.description: Abstract Audio deepfake detection has become increasingly challenging due to rapid advances in speech synthesis and voice conversion technologies, particularly under channel distortions, replay attacks, and real-world recording conditions. This paper proposes a resolution-aware audio deepfake detection framework that explicitly models and aligns multi-resolution spectral representations through cross-scale attention and consistency learning.

pmc-10847519.title: Multifaceted leaders: the double-edged sword effect of narcissistic leadership on employees’ work behavior
pmc-10847519.creator: Hao Chen, Lei Zhang, Liang Wang, Jiaying Bao, Zihan Zhang
pmc-10847519.description: So far, most studies have focused on exploring the negative effects of narcissistic leadership. However, little attention has been paid to whether narcissistic leadership also has a positive effect. This study is based on Conservation of Resources Theory and reveals that narcissistic leadership has a double-edged sword effect. By using Mplus7.

pmc-11633519.title: Insufficient Mechanical Loading Downregulates Piezo1 in Chondrocytes and Impairs Fracture Healing Through ApoE‐Induced Senescence
pmc-11633519.creator: Siming Jia, Weijian Liu, Mo Zhang, Lijun Wang, Chuan Ren, Chen Feng, Tao Zhang, Hongzhi Lv, Zhiyong Hou, Weiguo Zou, Yingze Zhang, Wei Tong, Juan Wang, Wei Chen
pmc-11633519.description: Insufficient mechanical loading impairs fracture healing; however, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Increasing evidence indicates that Piezo1 plays an important role in fracture healing, although the effect of Piezo1 on the endochondral ossification of chondrocytes has been overlooked. This study reports that mechanical unloading down‐regulates the expression of Piezo1 in chondrocytes and leads to fracture nonunion.

pmc-12290982.title: Classification of Pneumonia, Tuberculosis and Covid-19 from Chest X-Ray Images Using Convolution Neural Network Model
pmc-12290982.creator: J Kiche, Ivivi Mwaniki, Idah Orowe, Patrick Weke
pmc-12290982.description: Accurate and timely diagnosis of respiratory ailments like pneumonia, tuberculosis (TB), and COVID-19 is pivotal for effective patient care and public health interventions. Deep learning algorithms have emerged as potent tools in medical image classification, offering promise for automated diagnosis and screening.

pmc-12491288.title: The role of eosinophils and their activation state in hypereosinophilia-associated heart disease
pmc-12491288.creator: Usman Sunusi, Immaculeta Osuji, Benjamin Ziegelmeyer, Mario Medvedovic, Haley Todd, Joe Abou-Khalil, Nives Zimmermann
pmc-12491288.description: BackgroundCardiac complications in patients with hypereosinophilia cause significant morbidity and mortality. However, mechanisms of how eosinophilic inflammation causes heart damage are poorly understood.MethodsWe developed a model of hypereosinophilia-associated heart disease by challenging hypereosinophilic mice with a peptide from the cardiac myosin heavy chain.

pmc-12575469.title: Mapping Incidence and Prevalence Peak Data for SIR Modeling Applications
pmc-12575469.creator: Alexander C. Murph, G. Casey Gibson, Lauren J. Beesley, Nishant Panda, Lauren A. Castro, Sara Y. Del Valle, Carrie A. Manore, Dave A. Osthus
pmc-12575469.description: Infectious disease modeling and forecasting have played a key role in helping assess and respond to epidemics and pandemics. Recent work has leveraged data on disease peak infection and peak hospital incidence to fit compartmental models for the purpose of forecasting and describing the dynamics of a disease outbreak.

pmc-12957775.title: Accuracy of Marginal and Internal Adaptation of Advanced Lithium Disilicate Crowns Using Different Margin Designs (In Vitro Study)
pmc-12957775.creator: Hossameldin Hassan Abdelrazek Mohamed, Amir Azer, Rewaa G. AboElHassan
pmc-12957775.description: BackgroundAdvanced lithium disilicate glass ceramics offer excellent esthetics, but conservative crown preparations are not always the preferred choice. Various margin designs are available; however, more conservative vertical preparations (vertipreps) have less scientific evidence supporting their esthetic outcomes compared to shoulder or chamfer designs.

pmc-13155224.title: Targeting KRAS G12C in Rare Mesonephric Carcinoma of the Cervix: A Promising Response to Sotorasib
pmc-13155224.creator: Bryan Cho Wing Li, Joshua Jing Xi Li, Ka Yu Tse, Haonan Lu, Karen Kar Loen Chan
pmc-13155224.description: (DISH-negative), human papillomavirus–negative, PD-L1–negative, and intact mismatch repair proteins. Next-generation sequencing (NGS) was performed on the original surgical sample at the time of recurrence and identified a KRAS G12C mutation. Preoperative clinical and radiologic assessment indicated stage I disease. Consequently, the patient was subjected to radical hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and pelvic lymph node dissection.

pmc-13358290.title: Archived M184V/I Mutation and Risk of Virological Failure After Switching to Doravirine, Lamivudine, Tenofovir Disoproxil Fumarate: A National Observational Study (Dat’AIDS Cohort)
pmc-13358290.creator: Romain Palich, Axel Ursenbach, Nolwenn Hall, Agathe Becker, Clotilde Allavena, Olivier Robineau, Laurent Hocqueloux
pmc-13358290.description: Among 1282 virally suppressed people with HIV switching to doravirine/lamivudine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate, 40 (3.1%) experienced virological failure (VF) during follow-up (median 81 weeks). Archived M184V/I mutation (7.4% of study population) was not significantly associated with VF after adjustment (adjusted hazard ratio 1.36; 95%CI 0.51–3.66).

pmc-13530870.title: Prehospital Care Duration and 30‐Day Mortality Among Septic Shock
pmc-13530870.creator: Romain Jouffroy, Vincent Garrouste, Basile Gilbert, Stéphane Travers, Emmanuel Bloch-Laine, Patrick Ecollan, Vincent Bounes, Josiane Boularan, Benoit Vivien, Papa Gueye
pmc-13530870.description: BackgroundSeptic shock may occur in the prehospital setting requiring a prehospital mobile intensive care unit (MICU) intervention. The prehospital MICU is equipped to deliver antibiotics and hemodynamic optimization on scene in order to implement effective treatment measures within the initial hour.

pmc-13655481.title: What Makes Community Inclusion Work for Older Adults With an Intellectual Disability? An Application of the Normalisation Process Theory
pmc-13655481.creator: L. Taggart, A. Campbell, I. Doherty, K. Ensue, H. Ahmed, A. Hanna, L. Armstrong, B. Bunting, A. Ryan, C. O'Neill, M. Clarke, B. Leahy, S. Willis, J. Schofield, R. Stancliffe, A. Hassiotis
pmc-13655481.description: BackgroundOlder adults with intellectual disability experience high levels of loneliness and social exclusion. MATILDA is a community‐based intervention supporting participation in mainstream community groups through volunteer mentors.AimTo use Normalisation Process Theory (NPT) to explore the processes, mechanisms, and barriers influencing implementation and sustainability.

uslaw-usc-t49-s41720.title: 49 U.S.C. § 41720 — Joint venture agreements
uslaw-usc-t49-s41720.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s41720.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part A (Air Commerce And Safety); Subpart ii (Economic Regulation); Chapter 417 (Operations Of Carriers); Subchapter I (Requirements). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions.— In this section, the following definitions apply: (1) Joint venture agreement.— The term “joint venture agreement” means an agreement between two or more major air carriers on or after January 1.
